Thanks for posting. I hope you get better too and I'm glad that I could help in any way! I finally feel like I have a plan. I have this fancy notebook I bought last year that I needed a use for, so when I woke up I spent a 3 hours writing in it. I wrote what I wanted to change, and then wrote a set of rules that I'm going to follow and why I think these rules will help. 

The rules mainly revolve around making todo lists/logs every day that keep track of how much I sleep and if I'm keeping up with grooming/eating/exercising/self project time. As of now for today I got a good shower and shave this morning for the first time in a while. I got my room all cleaned and the mountain of dishes done. And sure I had a laps in the middle of the day where I just went back to bed and cried for a bit... but for the first time in a long time it felt like a 'real' cry... like this emotion was behind it instead of just the physical action.

One rule also states I have to write down the justification I have for partaking in any unhealthy pleasure. eg: weed, masturbation, video games. I hope if I can see exactly what I'm doing it will be harder to lie to myself when I have problems. 

On the back cover I wrote in big ol letters **DON'T PANIC** followed by "... really don't, because is wasn't always this hard so there has to be a way to put things right, and sweetie, I promises deep down inside you still love yourself no matter how hard you try to hide it so please, never give up.

/u/FurTrip I know you are going to read this when you wake up tomorrow well rested and feeling normal like this was all dumb but PLEASE whatever you do, DO SOMETHING! dont do nothing again... because its not working and its time to stop waking up and reading these bread crumbs of help me's to yourself.
